title: IELTS Vocabulary Practice - IELTS Vocabulary - Advanced Synonyms
subject: IELTS Vocabulary

questions.q: Many old buildings in the city have become **obsolete** and are being replaced.
questions.explain: 'Obsolete' means no longer produced or used; out of date.
questions.subject: IELTS Vocabulary

questions.q: Smartphones have become **ubiquitous** in modern society.
questions.explain: 'Ubiquitous' means present, appearing, or found everywhere.
questions.subject: IELTS Vocabulary

questions.q: The witness's story seemed **plausible**, although some details were missing.
questions.explain: 'Plausible' means (of an argument or statement) seeming reasonable or probable.
questions.subject: IELTS Vocabulary

questions.q: The economy has shown itself to be remarkably **resilient** despite the crisis.
questions.explain: 'Resilient' means able to withstand or recover quickly from difficult conditions.
questions.subject: IELTS Vocabulary

questions.q: This study challenges the existing **paradigm** of educational psychology.
questions.explain: A 'paradigm' is a typical example or pattern of something; a model.
questions.subject: IELTS Vocabulary

questions.q: The evidence presented was **compelling** enough to convict him.
questions.explain: 'Compelling' means evoking interest, attention, or admiration in a powerfully irresistible way; convincing.
questions.subject: IELTS Vocabulary
